title: Distinguish additive noise from a variational bottleneck
prompt: Implement additive or variational Gaussian bottleneck sampling with caller-supplied standard-normal noise. Without logvar return h+sigma*noise and zero KL; with logvar treat h as mu and return reparameterized z plus mean per-example KL to N(0,I). Evaluation returns the mean in either mode; noise and input shapes match.
